scope: Complete unchanged REQ-034 AC-1–10 and active requirement-to-verification goal; full local acceptance; final publication preservation is retained separately.

requirement.statement: Define and build the complete requirement-to-verification application capability on the audited primitives and verified reusable application foundation.
requirement.acceptance: AC-1: Pinned project-model bindings define requirement, method, case and execution vocabulary against the governing schema; edits, deletion and incompatible schema changes cannot silently reinterpret existing verification. AC-2: Cases retain an exact requirement basis, stable criterion IDs, validated native acceptance text ranges/quotes, complete or explicitly partial source coverage and exact criterion-to-method assignments; missing or duplicate obligations cannot become verified. AC-3: Controlled executions atomically preserve activity identity, exact method/requirement/design/supporting input states, conditions, actual observations and typed per-criterion passed/failed/blocked/not_run results with immutable receipts; prose outcomes and report links alone are insufficient. AC-4: Guarded result selection accounts for selected and competing executions, requires rationale for supersession, rejects unrelated scope and prevents a later unassessed failure or partial run from being silently bypassed in favor of an older passing result. AC-5: Analysis separates planning coverage, execution outcome, evidence drift/unknowns, assessed applicability and effective scoped verification. Full verification requires every declared obligation passed/applicable, complete source coverage and a controlled immutable conclusion; authored status alone cannot establish it. AC-6: Relevant requirement/method/design/support changes preserve historical execution/conclusions and require explicit reassessment or basis revision. Unrelated annotations do not retire applicability; unknown material and stale comparison/proposal guards cannot establish current verification. AC-7: Core, typed HTTP/client and CLI share guarded atomic operations, original-intent success recovery, stable identities and bounded complete reads, including invalid, partial, stale, interrupted, superseded and reopened/reassessed cases in two materially different configured domains. AC-8: A real currently unverified Tracer requirement retains unchanged acceptance and a declared method, genuine failing execution, justified correction, passing verification and later relevant-change reassessment. Original failures/candidates remain inspectable; failures are not manufactured to satisfy this lifecycle. AC-9: The shared workspace authors verification bases/executions/selections and explains results/outstanding work through shared services, retains drafts and uncertain-save recovery, and undergoes an independent fresh-agent task with material findings addressed and human validation explicitly separate. AC-10: Existing identity/history/evidence/outcomes and interface/storage compatibility are preserved, deliberate migrations are rehearsed if needed, deterministic export/SQLite backup recovery is verified, owning docs/register retain exact candidate evidence and uncertainties, and appropriate regression/architecture/quality gates pass unchanged.

criteria.actual: Both configured domains preserve original model interpretation through edit/deletion/restart, while incompatible current schema blocks writes. Invalid/ambiguous role bindings, metadata and payload bounds reject.

Exact native requirement/method/link revisions and UTF-16 acceptance quotes/ranges are validated; duplicate/overlapping/foreign scope rejects. Partial coverage and unassigned criteria remain explicit blockers even with passing results.

Controlled activity capture atomically retains exact basis and native/content/relationship support, conditions and explicit criterion results. Generic authored JSON/prose cannot forge ownership. Overflow and post-capture failure roll back receipts, native state, dependency indexes and command reservation. Prior activity interpretation retains original provenance separately.

Every registered activity requires explicit selected/historical/superseded accounting; invalid scope/replacements and stale proposals reject. New activities make earlier selection incomplete; original failed/not_run results survive selected passing replacements.

Analysis exposes distinct basis/source coverage, accounting, recorded outcomes, support drift/unknowns, assessed applicability and controlled conclusion. Explicit complete/applicable passing selection is required, and a current accounted not_run cannot conclude.

Changed governing semantics require explicit basis revision/new activity; accepted receipt review cannot override those semantics. Selected design support drift obeys pinned policy; unknown/reevaluation blocks. Unrelated annotations and drift of unselected historical support preserve the current selected conclusion. Original conclusions/outcomes remain immutable.

Core, typed HTTP/client and real CLI agree in engineering/research across restart, exact intent recovery, interrupted committed response, immutable reads and guarded lifecycle. Complete 100-activity workload is read only and explicitly accounted; activity101 and payload overflows reject atomically. Existing architecture/storage migration gates run unchanged.

Real REQ-011 unchanged criteria retain the genuine queue failure, justified direct-relationship comparison correction, passing exact candidate, first conclusion, subsequently observed justified comparison-source refactor, explicit reopening, actual new 9 unit/6 production-browser checks plus15 lifecycle regressions and current reconclusion. No manufactured failure or weakened acceptance. Original candidates, failure, activities and both conclusions remain inspectable.

Shared UI authors explicit bases, typed activities and result accounting, explains blockers and controls conclusions/reopening/revision. Drafts and exact input review survive map return, failed reads pause writes and lost-response recovery inspects one original committed command without replay. Independent fresh agent completed historical/current understanding, honest not_run authoring, draft return, accounting and reload/context inspection. Wording, catalogue repetition and navigation guidance findings addressed with retained original report. Human validation remains separate.

Full unchanged regression/architecture/quality run passed on exact source manifest; documentation and fresh-agent evidence retained. Native109 prepublication live/restored-backup audit confirms original objects, history, evidence, outcomes, canonical export parity and exact core/HTTP/CLI recovery; final publication preservation is retained separately.

limits: Independent agent inspection, not representative-human validation.
Synthetic domain fixtures do not validate physical products or regulatory conformity.
No authenticated-team/backend parity or arbitrary-scale readiness claim.
Catalogue authoring bounds are disclosed; exact headless selection remains available beyond UI method-catalogue bounds.
